## About
Steed Auto Repair, formerly Steed Alignment, is a family owned and operated independent auto repair shop on Commonwealth Ave in Buena Park. James, Dave and John run the shop, along with the rest of our team, and our technicians have many years of experience in the automotive field.
We started with alignments and grew into a full service automotive center. Our shop has the tools, diagnostic monitors and equipment to help diagnose and repair your vehicle right the first time. Smog check testing and repair is one of our specialties, gross polluters included, and our large shop area can take motor homes, RV's, cargo vans and large commercial vehicles.
We use original equipment replacement parts and keep dealer brake pads, filters, oils and small parts in stock so you're taken care of in less time. There may be cheaper parts out there, and we'll always tell you what we recommend for your repair.
Our customers come from Buena Park and nearby Fullerton, Anaheim, Stanton, Cerritos, Orange and Santa Ana. One reviewer wrote that we repaired their older Mustang when the Ford dealership would not because of its age. Another said we drove them to Enterprise for a rental and picked them up when the car was done. We may not be related, but you'll feel like we're family.

## Services
- Smog Check Inspection & Repair: We test and inspect with an ESP System and Dyno, and repairing smog failures, gross polluters included, is one of our specialties.
- Alignment (2 and 4 wheel): We started out as Steed Alignment, and alignments are still a big part of what we do.
- Brake & Tire Service: Brake work with dealer brake pads kept in stock, plus new tires mounted and balanced in our shop.
- Check Engine Light: Our diagnostic tools and monitors help us find the problem and repair it right the first time.
- Lube, Oil, Filter Change: Simple oil changes with oils, oil filters, air filters and cabin filters stocked right here in the shop.
- Transmissions (auto & manual): Automatic and manual transmission work, up to full transmission replacement.

## FAQ
Q: My car failed smog somewhere else. Can you help?
A: Yes. Bring it down. Repairing smog failures is one of our specialties, and we'll work to get you back on the road and ready to pass.

Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: Domestic and imports, including American, Japanese and European vehicles, from compact and luxury cars to sport utility vehicles.

Q: Do you offer a free inspection?
A: Yes. Bring your car in and mention our website for a free inspection.

Q: What's the fastest way to reach you?
A: Call 714-521-5781 during our normal operating hours. Email replies can take 24-48 hours.

Q: Who should I ask for when I call?
A: Ask for James, Dave or John. They run the shop and can answer your questions.
